Video Boy turns any video into a ROM with picture and sound for the Game Boy, Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance / Micro and Nintendo DS / 3DS.

**Downloads**
- `video-boy_VERSION_all.deb`: Linux desktop app for Ubuntu, Debian, Linux Mint, Pop!_OS … (`sudo apt install ./video-boy_VERSION_all.deb`)
- `video-boy-VERSION-linux.tar.gz`: Linux desktop app for any other distribution (`./install.sh`, or run `./video-boy` directly)
- `video-boy.html`: the complete converter as a single web page; open it in Chrome, Edge or Firefox, works offline

Or use it right in the browser: https://pedapeda.github.io/Video-Boy/web/

The command-line tool `videoboy.py` is in the source code (and included as `video-boy-cli` in the Linux packages).
